changelog:
Groundwork for faster, gentler catalog refreshes.

WHAT CHANGED

- Nothing you can see yet. The app now records a fuller fingerprint of each channel, so a later update can tell exactly which channels a provider changed, added or removed.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Refreshing a source works as before. Your favourites, watch history and guide choices stay as they are.

NOT YET

- Refreshes that change only what the provider changed come in a later update, after they are tested on a device.
